info.name: DTN Aviation Enhanced Flight Hazards (EFH) API

description.content: The DTN Aviation Enhanced Flight Hazards (EFH) API retrieves available turbulence (including Nowcast), icing, high ice water content (HIWC), thunderstorms, ozone, jet stream axis, space weather, and Quantitative Volcanic Ash (QVA) data.  Each data type has its own endpoint.  Filtering parameters allow to limit data requests in various ways, particularly in limiting the area for which to find data.
